members.name: tvg_conic_gradient_new
members.brief: Creates a new conic gradient object.

members.name: tvg_conic_gradient_set
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_conic_gradient_set(Tvg_Gradient grad, float cx, float cy, float angle)
description: The gradient sweeps a full turn clockwise around the center (`cx`, `cy`), beginning at `angle`. Color stop offsets from 0% to 100% map clockwise over one full turn from `angle`.

params.name: grad
params.description: The Tvg_Gradient object of which attributes are to be set.

params.name: cx
params.description: The horizontal coordinate of the center of the gradient.

params.name: cy
params.description: The vertical coordinate of the center of the gradient.

params.name: angle
params.description: The initial angle in degrees, measured clockwise from the 3 o'clock direction (positive x-axis).

notes: FillSpread options are ignored because the gradient always sweeps a full turn.

members.name: tvg_conic_gradient_get
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_conic_gradient_get(const Tvg_Gradient grad, float* cx, float* cy, float* angle)

params.name: grad
params.description: The Tvg_Gradient object of which to get the gradient attributes.

params.name: cx
params.description: The horizontal coordinate of the center of the gradient.

params.name: cy
params.description: The vertical coordinate of the center of the gradient.
